evidence.detail: The class recognizes @glo@ plus numbered @glo2@..@glo9@ forms, <glo>/<gloN> forms, matching closing tags, and explicit <glo=color> markup.
Its phase function derives an 8-bit phase from System.nanoTime using a 40 ms tick, and its color lookup combines that phase with glyph position before indexing one of nine 256-entry color palettes.
Static initialization builds the nine palettes from rainbow, grayscale and multi-stop RGB interpolation formulas; explicit glow color input is normalized through hue/palette conversion helpers.

The live font renderer detects the glow tags, stores the glow style/phase and uses this class's palette lookup per rendered glyph, making it a live animated text-color effect rather than a passive parser.

evidence.detail: The immutable record stores nine parsed values: width, height, filled width, fill color, background color, border color, embedded label/text, source/tag end index and progress-bar style.
RichTextProgressBarProcessor is the only exact-v308 owner/constructor and caches these records as the result of pbar parsing.
The progress-bar renderer reads the record fields directly to draw the frame/background/fill and to choose static versus animated gradient rendering.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 immutable parsed pbar element specification.

evidence.detail: The class parses pbar markup with optional style digit 2..7 and colon-delimited width/value/max/color/size-style fields, caching up to 256 parsed specs by String identity and tag range.
Parsed width is clamped to 20..300 pixels; current/max values are parsed as non-negative integers and converted to a clamped 0..1 fraction used to compute the interior filled width.
Its renderer draws outer/background rectangles and the filled progress region through rs/l/c. Static styles use the parsed fill color, while animated styles generate a per-pixel moving gradient.
Animated styles derive phase from nanoTime/8, use either 512- or 1536-step color cycles, and call R409 RichTextMotionEffectProcessor's redraw pulse helper so animated bars remain live.
